note: Curated offline subset of published crypto-library advisories. A scan reads only this file. Rows for pycrypto, cryptography (PyPI) and golang.org/x/crypto (Go) were taken from the OSV database (https://api.osv.dev/v1/query for the affected version, 2026-11-02): one row per CVE, the package's own ECOSYSTEM/SEMVER range; each row's source is its OSV record. A Go fixed version may be a pseudo-version (v0.0.0-<UTC timestamp>-<commit>), compared by its timestamp.
